measured.observer: windows of length 14..22 tested for EVERY period p <= 22 (not only 2-slot alternating words), at depth 6
measured.independence: the Poisson upper limit needs independent windows and is reported under that hypothesis; the charge does not use it

family_census.route: MARKOV: the charge is the expected number of trapping windows from this exact census (P(any) <= E[count]); no independence and no observed-zero rule of three is used
family_census.extended_lengths: 7..12 NOT enumerated exactly (canonical-word count too large); covered by the period<=12 observer below
family_census.premise: H4: kappa uniform on Z/12, independent of the slot; vanishing sums exact in Z[zeta] mod Phi_12
